entities.name: Ryūzō Saki
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ryūzō Saki  was a Japanese novelist and non-fiction writer, born in North Hamgyong, a province of what is now North Korea. He was interested in high-profile crimes in Japan and published a number of non-fiction books about Japanese crimes.
